b02cc1c87e70a267.description: About Masan Properties Masan Properties is a design-driven property developer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on creating refined and enduring living spaces, with a portfolio that includes residential and hospitality properties. Masan emphasizes architecture, interior design, and harmony with the surrounding environment, collaborating with selected architects and designers who value proportion, material quality, and the details of everyday living. The Role: Design & Project Manager, Real Estate Development Masan Properties is seeking a Design & Project Manager – Real Estate Development for a full-time, on-site position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing residential and hospitality projects from early planning and design stages through construction and handover. The manager will lead an existing in-house technical and site team and work closely with external consultants and contractors. Key Responsibilities Developing project briefs. Managing the design process. Reviewing drawings and material selections. Ensuring designs meet project requirements, budgets, and Masan’s quality standards. Overseeing project schedules. Overseeing consultant and contractor performance. Overseeing authority approvals. Overseeing tendering processes. Overseeing construction progress. Ensuring issues are resolved and projects are delivered successfully. Candidate Requirements The ideal candidate will possess a combination of strong design judgment, practical construction knowledge, and an understanding of the commercial considerations inherent in real estate development.

b06328db424471f9.description: عامل خدمات مساندة مهنته الأساسية تحميل وتنزيل بالاضافة إلى متابعة اعمال التحميل والتنزيل لدى المستأجرين والتأكد من كونهم ملتزمين بالاشتراطات وتوجييههم باتباع السياسات والاجراءات المتبعة والبلاغ عن المخالفات الحاصلة.

b0ab632196cf877a.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking a Manager People Analytics to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is situated within the Workplace Engineering function, which operates at the intersection of HR analytics and Product Engineering. The position reports directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, within the Data discipline of the People department. Role Context and Purpose The Workplace Engineering function transforms workforce data into "People Products" designed to enhance performance. This role moves beyond traditional reporting to engineer tools and insights that influence future outcomes. Experienced data professionals at Canonical integrate software, data, and business objectives to transform analytical artifacts into strategic assets, elevating decision-making and innovation across global operations, including sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources. They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, developing experiments, automations, and products that convert insights into tangible outcomes. The role also contributes to shaping the future of the AI/Data stack in open source. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor a specialized squad comprising People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers, functioning as a product squad leader. Serve as Product Owner for People Science initiatives, translating human behavioral intent for engineering teams. Develop strategic insights and drive business outcomes by moving beyond descriptive metrics to predictive and prescriptive analytics, such as forecasting attrition risk based on engagement data. Act as a "Translator-in-Chief," converting complex data models into clear narratives and leading the development of AI Agents for real-time insight delivery to managers. Ensure the People Data Stack is secure, compliant with GDPR and privacy regulations, and serves as a single source of truth for all People-related offerings. Identify opportunities to integrate high-tech solutions into People offerings to optimize human involvement and maximize value. Required Qualifications and Skills A background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, with proficiency in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL), or software engineering. Strong skills in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript), software engineering, data visualization (*, Superset, Tableau), and automation. Ability to translate business questions into key research objectives and identify appropriate methodologies for execution, synthesis, and analysis of findings. Proven ability to lead and guide teams to execute against planned roadmaps, demonstrating a strong mentor/coaching mindset. Willingness to challenge the status quo and maintain resilience in the face of challenges. Ambition to contribute to the development of tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source. An exceptional academic record from high school and university. Business-level written and spoken English. Sincere personal motivation aligned with Canonical's mission. Availability for international travel 2-4 times a year for company events, each up to two weeks long. Experience required: 5-10 years. About Canonical Canonical is a technology firm recognized for its contributions to open source. Its platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company serves leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across various sectors. Canonical is founder-led, profitable, and expanding. Operating with a globally distributed collaboration model since 2004, Canonical maintains no central headquarters, with most colleagues working remotely. The company emphasizes high expectations and a commitment to excellence, fostering an environment that encourages continuous learning and development. Equal Opportunity Employer Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination. The company values diversity of experience, perspectives, and background, recognizing their contribution to a better work environment and improved products. All applications receive fair consideration regardless of identity.

b0c3950b734305d6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قرطاس الخليج لصناعة الورق عن مهندس كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير عمليات التصنيع الكيميائي، وإعداد برامج التشغيل والصيانة لوحدات الإنتاج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة عمليات التصنيع الكيميائي المختلفة، مثل البلمرة، الهدرجة، الأكسدة، البلورة، التبخير، والتقطير. متابعة الظروف التشغيلية لوحدات الإنتاج، بما في ذلك الضغط ودرجة الحرارة والتدفق. تحديد وتطبيق الطرق الفعالة لتطوير عمليات الإنتاج وتحسين جودة المنتج النهائي. إعداد برامج تشغيل وحدات تصنيع المنتجات الكيميائية، ووضع خطط العمل التنفيذية ومتابعة تنفيذها. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية لوحدات وتجهيزات التصنيع الكيميائي وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكيميائية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق مبادئ عمليات التصنيع الكيميائي. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد فرص التحسين وحل المشكلات التشغيلية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكيميائي ضمن فريق متخصص في منشآت شركة قرطاس الخليج لصناعة الورق بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على الابتكار والتحسين المستمر لعمليات الإنتاج. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكيميائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

b0f964745e0de41a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة الحسابات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بترحيب وتلبية رغباتهم فيما يتعلق بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في المدينة المنورة، وتتطلب التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

b05a37b17cc400ad.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جست كلين للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم نجاح الشركاء التشغيليين وضمان تقديم أفضل تجربة لهم، بالإضافة إلى المساهمة في تنمية الأعمال من خلال إدارة علاقات العملاء وتعزيز فرص المبيعات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وإدارة قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، وتحديث بيانات الاتصال والعناوين بشكل دوري. التواصل مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو وسائل الاتصال المختلفة للترويج للخدمات والمنتجات. تقديم العروض التجارية وشرح مزايا الخدمات والميزات التنافسية بما يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. التفاوض على الأسعار وتقديم الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المعتمدة لإتمام عمليات البيع. متابعة دورة البيع كاملة بدءًا من استقطاب العميل وحتى إتمام التعاقد أو البيع وتوثيق العمليات ذات العلاقة. تحصيل مستحقات العملاء ومتابعة الديون المستحقة والتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية لضمان السداد في الوقت المحدد. إعداد تقارير دورية عن نشاط المبيعات، الفرص التجارية، وحالة العملاء ومشاركتها مع الإدارة. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء والشركاء بما يدعم النمو واستمرارية الأعمال. دعم العمليات التشغيلية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية متابعة الأداء اليومي وحل المشكلات التشغيلية التي قد تواجه الشركاء. يشمل ذلك التنسيق الفعال مع الفرق الداخلية المختلفة لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة عالية وتحقيق أهداف الخدمة المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتنمية الأعمال. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في جست كلين للتجارة.

b08a6d107d5b51e3.description: About the Role Guerlain is seeking a Brand Marketing Manager to develop and execute the local marketing strategy for the brand across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role, based in Jeddah, Makkah, requires aligning local initiatives with regional and global brand visions. The manager will lead 360° marketing campaigns, product launches, and client engagement strategies to enhance brand desirability and business growth within the Saudi market. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the Saudi market, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives. Adapt international campaigns to local market needs while maintaining brand consistency. Manage the execution of product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retail marketing initiatives. Monitor campaign performance and optimize activities based on business results and market insights. Collaborate with retail and commercial teams to drive traffic, sales, and brand awareness. Define and develop annual retail marketing and wholesale trade marketing plans. Ensure strong in-store execution and premium brand presentation across all Guerlain counters and boutiques. Uphold and implement regional PR guidelines locally, supporting press and influencer activities as needed. Ensure correct asset selection and implementation across paid and social media channels in line with regional guidelines. Partner with the CRM team to implement and utilize CRM tools and initiatives, supporting clientelling and VIC experiences. Develop and manage the annual marketing budget (media, PR, trade), monitoring expenditures and ensuring optimal ROI. Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activities, providing strategic recommendations. Work closely with various internal departments and external agencies to ensure flawless execution of initiatives. Key Performance Indicators Achievement of sales and market share objectives. Successful execution of marketing campaigns and product launches. Growth in brand awareness and engagement. Return on Investment (ROI) for marketing investments. Retail activation performance and CRM results. Excellence in event execution and budget management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. A Master's degree is considered an advantage. 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment The Brand Marketing Manager will work closely with regional teams, retailers, and external agencies to strengthen Guerlain's position as a leading luxury beauty brand in the Saudi market. This role involves significant cross-functional collaboration and strategic input.

b007e816d00f8b77.description: About the Role FAENA is seeking a Hygiene Manager to oversee food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards across FAENA The Red Sea in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing hygiene procedures, HACCP requirements, and inspections, ensuring the property is prepared for opening and maintains high standards during daily operations. The Hygiene Manager will work closely with Culinary, Food & Beverage, Stewarding, and other teams. Key Responsibilities Oversee hygiene, sanitation, and food safety standards across the property in line with applicable regulations and FAENA requirements. Manage the implementation and ongoing review of HACCP procedures and food safety management systems. Plan and conduct hygiene inspections, audits, and risk assessments in food preparation, storage, and service areas. Monitor food handling, storage, cleaning, and sanitation practices, and follow up on any identified gaps. Coordinate microbiological testing, water quality checks, and other required hygiene monitoring activities. Investigate food safety and hygiene incidents and follow through on corrective and preventive actions. Work closely with Culinary, Stewarding, Food & Beverage, and Engineering to address hygiene concerns and maintain operational readiness. Prepare and deliver food safety and hygiene briefings and training in coordination with relevant departments. Maintain accurate hygiene records, inspection reports, audit findings, and supporting documentation. Coordinate preparations for relevant authority inspections and external food safety audits. Provide management with updates on hygiene performance, key risks, and required improvements. Support pre-opening preparations and ensure hygiene procedures are in place ahead of hotel operations. Promote safe working practices and encourage consistent hygiene standards across the teams. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in hygiene management, preferably within the hospitality or food service industry. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, specifically at FAENA The Red Sea. The role requires collaboration with various operational departments to ensure comprehensive hygiene and food safety compliance.

b07b8e1a7386876d.description: About IBM Consulting IBM Consulting focuses on building long-term client relationships and fostering global collaboration. Professionals within IBM Consulting work with leading companies across various industries, assisting them in their hybrid cloud and AI initiatives. The environment supports continuous learning and innovation, encouraging individuals to challenge existing norms and develop effective solutions. Role Overview IBM is seeking a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA SCM PP to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing and configuring SAP ECC Production Planning (PP) modules for clients, ensuring the successful delivery of SAP SCM PP projects. The consultant will provide expert services, guiding clients through the implementation process to achieve their business objectives. Key Responsibilities Design and configure SAP SCM PP solutions to meet specific client business requirements. Provide expert consulting services, guiding clients through the implementation process. Offer training and support to clients to ensure effective use of the SAP SCM PP system. Collaborate closely with clients to understand their business needs and identify improvement opportunities. Ensure successful delivery of SAP SCM PP projects, adhering to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Required Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in SAP SCM PP implementation and configuration. Demonstrated ability to deliver SAP SCM PP projects successfully. Experience in providing expert consulting services to clients. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative environment, supported by strategic partners and robust IBM technology, including Red Hat.

b0c4bec789cc95fb.description: We are looking for a Logistics Operations Assistant to join our team and contribute to the smooth flow of daily operations. Your responsibilities will include organizing and coordinating shipments, managing inventory, and providing administrative support to ensure supply chain efficiency. If you have strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply. Key Responsibilities: Coordinate and follow up on shipping, customs clearance, and logistics operations. Assist in inventory management and ensure accurate record-keeping. Provide administrative support to the operations and logistics departments. Communicate with suppliers and customers to resolve any inquiries or issues. Prepare daily and periodic reports on inbound and outbound shipments. Contribute to improving logistics operations procedures.

b0fa71daba4a5383.description: About Foodics Foodics is a restaurant management ecosystem and payment technology provider established in 2014. Headquartered in Riyadh, the company operates offices across five countries and serves customers and partners in over 35 countries globally, having processed more than 6 billion orders. Foodics is a rapidly expanding SaaS company in the MENA region, supported by three rounds of funding, including a recent $170 million round. Role Overview The Sales Expansion Team Leader will manage an outbound sales team focused on generating revenue growth from existing clients. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah Province, and involves directing lead generation within the current customer base, coaching representatives on cross-selling and upselling new product lines, and executing strategies to increase Average Revenue Per User (ARPU). The role requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage incoming new branch sales requests from existing customers. Generate and send quotes promptly, ensuring accuracy and alignment with customer needs. Track expansion requests and ensure timely follow-ups to close deals efficiently. Identify new upselling and cross-selling opportunities from existing customers through outbound activities. Identify and recommend additional products to maximize revenue from expansion deals. Ensure that every expansion quote includes relevant upsell/cross-sell products before sending to the customer. Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of expansion sales. Communicate effectively with customers regarding their expansion needs and available solutions. Maintain accurate records of expansion requests in the CRM system. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of experience in a relevant sales or team leadership role. Demonstrated ability to manage sales teams and drive revenue growth. Experience with outbound sales, cross-selling, and upselling strategies. Proficiency in CRM systems for tracking sales activities and customer interactions. Work Environment and Benefits Foodics offers competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and potential for shares. The company supports personal development through regular training and an annual learning stipend. Employees join a diverse team of over 30 nationalities working across 14 countries. The work environment provides autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals.

b08ede654fe19566.description: About the Role People Group is seeking a City Operations Director to establish and lead the operational framework for a new development in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time executive role involves building the City Operations function from the ground up, defining how the urban destination will operate as an integrated, smart, and sustainable environment. The successful candidate will report directly to the CEO. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the overall City Operations strategy, vision, and operating model. Establish the City Operations department, including its organizational structure, governance frameworks, policies, and operational standards. Oversee the operational strategy for district cooling systems and associated energy infrastructure, ensuring efficiency and sustainability. Lead the development and implementation of the Smart City operations strategy, integrating smart infrastructure, IoT, and digital platforms. Develop and implement an integrated city mobility and transportation operations strategy, including parking, traffic, and public transport management. Establish and oversee the delivery of all city-wide operational services, such as public realm maintenance, waste management, security, and community services. Lead the development of the operational readiness and mobilization strategy, ensuring infrastructure and services are fully commissioned. Establish operational budgets, cost management strategies, and commercial performance frameworks, including procurement and contract management. Build and maintain relationships with government entities, regulators, utility providers, and strategic partners. Operational Focus Areas The role involves strategic oversight across several critical operational domains: District Cooling & Utilities Management: Ensuring efficient, reliable, and sustainable cooling operations and utility coordination. Smart City & Technology Integration: Overseeing the integration of smart infrastructure, IoT, and digital platforms, and establishing centralized monitoring capabilities. Mobility, Traffic & Parking Management: Developing strategies for integrated city mobility, traffic flow, parking operations, and public transport interfaces. Integrated City Services & Infrastructure Operations: Managing public realm, infrastructure maintenance, waste management, security, and community services. Candidate Profile We are seeking a senior operations leader with a proven track record in establishing and managing complex, large-scale urban environments, integrated infrastructure, or major destination operations. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of relevant experience. Required Qualifications and Experience Significant senior leadership experience in city operations, urban operations, integrated infrastructure management, or large-scale destination operations. Experience establishing an operational function, operating model, and governance framework from inception. Strong exposure to district cooling, utilities, smart city infrastructure, and integrated technology platforms. Experience overseeing parking, mobility, traffic management, and public realm operations. A strong understanding of integrated service delivery and the management of multiple operational functions. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Jeddah. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b09db7285d5ff70c.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Refund Lead Auditor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is for an experienced professional capable of conducting work with general directions, focusing on developing solutions to challenges requiring analysis and addressing escalated issues. The position involves complex operational activities, including researching industries for revenue benchmarking and developing audit reports within established policies and procedures. Refund Planning Responsibilities Review and study refund policies to stay current on refund limit utilization, risk control authorizations, and applicable margins, ensuring adherence to ZATCA’s rules, regulations, policies, and procedures. Develop and update assessment templates and audit tools in accordance with operational procedures and policies to facilitate customer request analysis and timely evaluation. Keep abreast of the latest developments, news, and updates by industry type and sector (*, business and insurance, telecommunication, consumer goods) to incorporate new tax practices adopted by taxpayers and businesses into assessments and audit reviews. Maintain and update refund manuals, eligibility criteria, legal requirements, and supporting documents by taxpayer type, integrating them into computer-aided audit tools to facilitate audit assessment and review. Refund Operations and Case Management Consolidate, categorize, and prioritize refund requests and schedules, sorting them by tax/industry type and ensuring dispatch to relevant audit teams for assessment and review. Review refund applications and requests, examine the validity of legal documents presented by taxpayers, and ensure completeness of supporting documents prior to case assessment and evaluation. Gather necessary data for desk audits, communicate with relevant stakeholders (account managers, taxpayers, banks, audit bureau, government entities) to obtain information and clarifications, and consult with the legal function for contractual structures to safeguard applicant legitimacy. Research public news, articles, databases, and shared channels to investigate and understand taxpayers’ business activity, including structure, size, process, and jurisdictions. Study and assess taxpayers’ financial status, income statements, financial strength and capabilities, and revenue streams to compare with benchmarks and similar industries, deciding on the appropriate assessment approach (actual, estimated, reduced assessments). Inspect and investigate taxpayers’ declarations, pinpoint high-risk and speculative issues, detect non-compliant cases, and communicate with internal stakeholders to avoid potential risks, including tax evasion. Consolidate legal and financial observations, study, and evaluate them against pre-approved eligibility criteria and refund requirements to recommend approval/rejection decisions in line with applicable policies and procedures. Manage the development of audit reports, including tax assessments (actual/reduced/estimated assessments), to identify taxpayers’ refund amounts. Develop lists of compliant taxpayers with accepted refunds and related amounts, submitting them to internal committees to secure necessary approvals for payment release/transfer. Monitor taxpayer objections and appeals, ensuring coordination with Legal Affairs or AMANA to resolve disputes and support key testimonies by providing clarifications on final audit findings and results. Maintain and update refund operations-related systems and databases, ensuring all audit findings are administered and stored securely to facilitate data exchange with internal stakeholders and other government agencies. Reporting and Support Draft refund audit reports to highlight recommendations and conclusions along with relevant evidence, proofs, and supporting documents, escalating them for revision and verification. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. This role requires professionals capable of conducting work with general directions and developing solutions to complex challenges. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

b0b95f4a46dae459.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد اللازمة، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف أنواع المنشآت (المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية، الاستمرارية، والتأريض. تشخيص الأعطال في التمديدات الكهربائية، وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مكان العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك. سيعمل الفني الكهربائي ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات، وستكون مسؤولياته محورية لضمان جودة وسلامة المشاريع الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في تبوك.

b0c35a400f2e305d.description: About Adobe Adobe focuses on transforming the world through digital experiences, enabling individuals and global brands to design and deliver exceptional digital interactions. The company empowers users to create powerful images, videos, and applications, and redefines how businesses engage with customers across various platforms. The Role of Director, Customer Value Adobe is seeking a Director, Customer Value to serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership within its key customer accounts across the Middle East. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, focuses on driving measurable business outcomes from Adobe investments, particularly within complex, customer-facing enterprises where digital experience, loyalty, and personalized engagement are critical for growth. The position operates at the intersection of sales, customer success, and delivery, adopting a long-term, outcome-led perspective on the customer journey. The Director is responsible for orchestrating cross-functional alignment, establishing value governance, accelerating adoption, and communicating business impact, with an annual salary ranging from 905,000 SAR to 1,310,000 SAR. Key Responsibilities Partner with customer executives to understand enterprise priorities, transformation ambitions, business challenges, and investment criteria, including the goals of major Middle East organizations to scale digital services and customer experiences; define a shared vision for Adobe-enabled outcomes. Translate priorities into a joint value roadmap, linking prioritized use cases, Adobe capabilities, business owners, dependencies, milestones, and measurable success indicators. Tailor value hypotheses to customer economics, such as customer acquisition, loyalty, conversion, digital channel adoption, ancillary revenue, and service experience. Collaborate with the Adobe ecosystem to align engagement plans with strategic account priorities. Unite Adobe Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, technical specialists, and partners around agreed value milestones and decision points. Proactively identify risks, misalignment, and barriers to value realization. Coordinate executive escalations when necessary, ensuring clear ownership, timely engagement from relevant stakeholders, and alignment on resolution plans that protect customer outcomes. Guide customers through business change considerations, operating model alignment, and adoption priorities required to realize value. Define value hypotheses, baseline measures, target KPIs, and an evidence-based approach to tracking business impact. Establish executive governance and business review cadences to validate progress, test assumptions, address gaps, and evolve the value roadmap. Build compelling executive value narratives, scorecards, and customer success stories that differentiate realized benefits from forecast or potential benefits. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in customer success leadership, strategic customer engagement, digital transformation, or comparable senior customer-facing roles within enterprise SaaS and cloud technology organizations, with a proven ability to drive measurable business outcomes. Strong executive presence and demonstrated experience engaging, influencing, and building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, including the ability to navigate high-pressure situations, manage sensitive executive escalations, and lead challenging conversations with confidence. Proven ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, translating executive priorities into actionable plans while orchestrating internal teams, partners, and stakeholders to drive alignment, resolve challenges, and accelerate customer outcomes. Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to understand customer business models, identify value opportunities, and articulate how technology investments contribute to strategic priorities, operational improvements, and measurable business impact. Solid understanding of enterprise SaaS and cloud technologies, digital transformation, and customer experience strategies. Experience with marketing technology (MarTech) platforms and ecosystems, particularly in areas such as customer data, personalization, and digital marketing, is a strong advantage. Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer relationships, ideally within large, matrixed organizations and across multiple business and technology stakeholders. Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to develop compelling executive briefings, strategic value roadmaps, business reviews, customer success stories, and narratives that communicate business impact to senior audiences. Strong collaboration and orchestration skills, with experience working across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and partner ecosystems to align priorities, influence decisions, and deliver customer outcomes without direct authority. An understanding of the Middle East business environment, including the dynamics of large regional enterprises, complex stakeholder structures, and varying levels of digital maturity. Experience across customer-centric industries such as travel and hospitality, retail, etc., is advantageous. Application Process Candidates meeting the above qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh.

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field. Nice to Have ServiceNow certifications: CSA, CIS – Security Incident Response, CIS – Vulnerability Response. Testing certifications (ISTQB Foundation or Advanced). Experience with other automation tools (Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, Postman). Experience in banking, government or other regulated sectors in the UAE/GCC.

b08d8fedd88e3697.description: About the Role AWN ENTERPRISES is seeking a Food Cost Controller to join our team in Al Khobar. This full-time role involves monitoring and analyzing food and beverage costs, managing recipe costing, overseeing inventory, and ensuring compliance with financial controls. The position requires close coordination with various teams to optimize cost efficiency and maintain accurate financial reporting. Key Responsibilities Monitor actual food and beverage costs against budgeted and theoretical costs for business units. Analyze food cost percentages, consumption trends, price fluctuations, and cost variances, identifying deviations and recommending corrective actions. Prepare and maintain standardized recipe costing sheets, including ingredient quantities, unit costs, portion sizes, and yield calculations. Calculate and review the cost and gross profit margins of menu items, bakery products, beverages, and catering menus. Monitor inventory levels and ensure accurate recording of stock receipts, issues, transfers, consumption, and returns. Conduct and supervise periodic physical stock counts across warehouses, restaurants, bakeries, and central kitchens. Review purchase prices and compare supplier quotations to identify cost-saving opportunities. Monitor food wastage, spoilage, preparation losses, portion control, and complimentary staff meals across all outlets. Prepare monthly food cost statements, inventory reports, consumption analysis, and cost variance reports for management. Support month-end closing by ensuring stock records, inventory valuations, and cost allocations are completed accurately. Inventory and Operational Monitoring The role involves comprehensive oversight of inventory and operational costs. This includes reconciling physical stock against system records, investigating discrepancies, and monitoring stock ageing and expiry dates to minimize losses. Additionally, the Food Cost Controller will verify stock transfers and ensure proper documentation, as well as monitor purchasing quantities against consumption patterns and approved operational requirements. A key aspect is highlighting unusual price increases and deviations from procurement procedures. Reporting and Compliance This position is responsible for robust reporting and ensuring compliance with financial controls. This includes reconciling purchases, inventory movements, and consumption for accurate food cost reporting. The Food Cost Controller will maintain proper documentation for all inventory and cost-related activities, support internal and external audits, and coordinate with the Finance department to ensure accurate posting and classification of food and beverage costs in ERP systems like SAP. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in food cost control, inventory control, or cost accounting. Experience preferably within restaurants, hotels, catering, or multi-outlet F&B operations. Practical experience in recipe costing, stocktaking, inventory reconciliation, and food cost analysis. Experience working with SAP or other ERP systems is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, requiring collaboration with various operational and financial teams to achieve cost efficiency and accurate financial reporting.

Support transition from project execution to plant operations. Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external project stakeholders. Liaise with consultants, contractors, suppliers, government authorities, and regulatory agencies. Provide regular project status updates, risk assessments, and financial reports to senior management. Ensure adherence to quality management procedures and corporate governance standards. Maintain effective risk management practices and ensure project documentation is properly controlled and maintained. Experience within manufacturing, chemical, construction materials, industrial production, or related sectors. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable. This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure. We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects. Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. What Are We Looking For❓ Essential Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, prioritizing algorithmic depth over superficial multi-language breadth. Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns. Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience. Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software. Comprehensive mental model of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management. Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives. Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors. Expectations by Seniority Level Core requirements apply universally, with ownership and operational scale adjusting based on candidate seniority. Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Prior agentic experience is not required; mentorship is provided to expand scope over well-defined modules. Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production services. Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations. Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling. Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling. Active open-source contributions or community engagement. Out of Scope Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem. Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation. Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows. Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning. Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally. Technical Standards & Architecture Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
